constraints.name: subtree_strict_less_count
constraints.description: For each vertex i, the number of vertices j in the subtree of i such that a_j < a_i must equal the given c_i.
constraints.formal: ∀ i, |{ j : j is in subtree(i) ∧ a_j < a_i }| = c_i

constraints.name: output_value_range
constraints.description: If a solution exists, the output integers a_i must satisfy 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9. It is guaranteed that if any solution exists, there is one within this range.
